BlogSpace is an offline-first blogging app. Every post is stored in an SQLite database on this device, so you can write, edit, search and delete posts without an internet connection.

• Create, edit, view and delete posts offline
• Attach a photo from the gallery or camera
• Search titles and text (partial, case-insensitive)
• Select several posts to delete or publish together
• Share a post (text and photo) with email or any app
• Publish one or many posts to your Blogger blog

• Long-press a post in the Posts tab to start selecting.
• Use “Select all” or “Clear selection” from the selection bar.
• Open a post and tap Share to email it with its photo.
• Set up publishing once in the Publish tab.

Posts and photos stay in the app’s private storage. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose Publish. Google sign-in is handled by Google Play services; the app never sees your password and stores no passwords or tokens.
